subject.title: refactor(tests): consolidate CLI command surface fixtures

question: After a rebase resolves the current merge conflict, should this broad CLI test-fixture consolidation be retained as one reviewable refactor or narrowed into smaller owner-area changes?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and cross-cutting test ownership mean the acceptable consolidation boundary is a maintainer judgment, not an automated cleanup choice.

options.title: Retain as one refactor
options.body: Keep the unified fixture cleanup if the rebased patch preserves all focused test behavior and its proof is supplied.

options.title: Split by test owner
options.body: Separate configuration, device, plugin, skill, and model test fixtures if review shows the shared refactor obscures distinct ownership boundaries.

recommendation.title: Retain as one refactor
recommendation.body: Keep the unified fixture cleanup if the rebased patch preserves all focused test behavior and its proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author supplied the focused refactor and its stated validation, and is the available contributor most directly positioned to rebase and clarify its intended scope.
